name: Hotjar
description: Hotjar (part of Contentsquare) is an experience-intelligence platform for understanding and improving user behavior on websites/apps — "go from insight to impact, fast."
best_for: Positioned for product, design, and marketing teams who want to "deliver experiences that convert" by understanding user journeys and reducing drop-offs.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 200k monthly sessions, 1 month of analytics data access, 1 project.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: From $39/month billed annually ($49/month billed monthly), starting at 7k monthly sessions. 13 months of data access, 3 projects.

cons: Hotjar is now sold under Contentsquare's unified "Experience Analytics" pricing and plan tiers (Free/Growth/Pro/Enterprise), not a separately branded standalone price list -- a buyer evaluating "Hotjar" today is really pricing Contentsquare's platform.
The Growth plan's session allowance starts at 7k monthly sessions and scales the price up from there, so actual cost depends on real traffic volume, not a single flat number.
Pro and Enterprise both require a sales conversation ("Let's talk") with no published price.
features: Integrations with Google Analytics, HubSpot, Optimizely

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.
